Color Code Picker

Convert colors instantly between HEX and RGB formats using this color picker online.

How the Color Code Picker works

Use this tool to convert between hexadecimal color strings and individual RGB channels. You can enter a standard six-character string into the HEX color input, such as #ef4444. The tool reads the two-character pairs for red, green, and blue, converting them into standard decimal values between 0 and 255.

Alternatively, you can provide values directly into the R, G, and B input fields. Each channel requires an integer from 0 through 255. When you update any of the RGB fields, the tool calculates the corresponding base-16 equivalent and updates the HEX output. You can use these values directly in CSS stylesheets, design software, or graphic editing workflows without manual calculation.

Formula used

HEX uses base-16 pairs; each channel is 0–255

SymbolMeaning
hexsix hex digits, e.g. #3b82f6
r, g, bred, green and blue channel values

FF is 255 and 00 is 0, so #000000 is black and #FFFFFF is white. Enter a full six-digit hex code — the three-digit shorthand is expanded before converting.

Inputs used: HEX color (e.g. #3b82f6), R (0–255), G (0–255), B (0–255).

Worked example

The following steps demonstrate how the tool converts the default hex code #ef4444 into RGB values.

  • Enter #ef4444 into the HEX color input field.
  • Split the hex string into its three two-digit base-16 pairs: 'ef' for red, '44' for green, and '44' for blue.
  • Convert each pair to base-10: hexadecimal 'ef' equals 239, while hexadecimal '44' equals 68.
  • Read the converted results: R is 239, G is 68, and B is 68.

Result:

  • HEX: #ef4444
  • R: 239
  • G: 68
  • B: 68

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between HEX and RGB color codes?
HEX represents colors using a six-character hexadecimal base-16 string prefixed by a hash. RGB represents the same colors using three decimal integers from 0 to 255 for red, green, and blue channels.
Does this tool require the hash symbol in HEX codes?
You can include or omit the '#' prefix when entering a code into the HEX field. The tool parses the standard six hexadecimal characters automatically.
What happens if an RGB channel exceeds 255?
Standard 8-bit RGB channels only accept values from 0 to 255. Values outside this range are invalid and will not produce an accurate color match.
What formula does the Color Code Picker use?
It uses HEX uses base-16 pairs; each channel is 0–255, where hex is the six hex digits, e.g. #3b82f6; r, g, b is the red, green and blue channel values.
How do I read the result?
FF is 255 and 00 is 0, so #000000 is black and #FFFFFF is white. Enter a full six-digit hex code — the three-digit shorthand is expanded before converting.
